title: FP8/INT8 benchmark matrix v1 (working)
content:
NOTE: This is a working sheet snapshot. Numbers move as we rerun with pinned clocks/driver and as scheduler knobs land. Use for internal decisioning only.

Last updated: 2026-02-27 (Isabella)

====================================================================
SHEET OVERVIEW / DEFINITIONS
====================================================================

Models (top hosted list for sprint):
- llama-3.1-70b-instruct ("L3.1-70B")
- llama-3.1-8b-instruct ("L3.1-8B")
- mixtral-8x7b-instruct ("Mixtral-8x7B")
- qwen2.5-72b-instruct ("Qwen2.5-72B")
- gemma-2-27b-it ("Gemma2-27B")
- mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3 ("Mistral-7B")

GPU tabs in this doc:
- H100 SXM 80GB (CUDA 12.4 baseline; driver 550.54.14 pinned when noted)
- A100 SXM 80GB (CUDA 12.2/12.4 mix early; now targeting pinned)
- L4 24GB (limited coverage; only smaller models + subset workloads)

Kernel modes (as logged by runtime metrics tagging - see pr-19934):
- BASELINE_BF16: current default kernels (bf16 attention/matmul)
- FP8_E4M3: FP8 attention + fp8-friendly matmul paths where available
- INT8_W8A8: INT8 matmul (W8A8) + baseline attention unless FP8 attention enabled separately
- MIXED: FP8 attention + INT8 matmul (only for eligible shapes; falls back per guardrails)

Workloads (suite v3-ish; see prompt suite doc for exact prompts; high-level params below):
- W1: chat_short
  - prompt_len p50~256 (p95~512), max_new_tokens=256
  - concurrency=16, target_batching=continuous
- W2: chat_long
  - prompt_len p50~2048 (p95~4096), max_new_tokens=256
  - concurrency=8
- W3: rag_longctx
  - prompt_len p50~8192 (p95~12288), max_new_tokens=128
  - concurrency=4
- W4: tool_json
  - prompt_len p50~512 (p95~1024), max_new_tokens=256, structured JSON schema on
  - concurrency=8

Metrics:
- TTFT p50/p95 (ms): time-to-first-token end-to-end.
- TPOT p50/p95 (ms): time-per-output-token (decode phase), end-to-end.
- Throughput (tok/s/GPU): steady-state output tokens/sec per GPU (aggregate over run).
- ErrRate (%): non-2xx or runtime fallback/errors during run.
- CV (%): coefficient of variation for throughput across N runs (higher = noisier).

Run protocol (current target):
- N=5 runs per cell unless noted.
- Warmup: 120s; measure: 300s.
- Clocks: locked where possible (H100: 1410 MHz mem / 1980 MHz gfx), otherwise "auto" noted.
- Artifacts: stored in benchmark-lab output bucket; metadata includes git SHA, image, driver, clocks (pr-19880).

Interpretation heuristics (working):
- Meaningful win threshold: >= +8% tok/s OR >= -8% TPOT p50 at comparable ErrRate, with CV <= 4%.
- TTFT regressions > +10% are treated as launch/scheduler risk even if TPOT improves.

====================================================================
TAB: H100 SXM 80GB
====================================================================

Environment notes:
- Preferred cluster: us-east1 runtime-bench-h100 (dedicated nodes) to avoid contention.
- Pinned good config: driver 550.54.14, CUDA 12.4 image runtime-bench:1.22.0-rc3, clocks locked.
- Known bad config (DO NOT COMPARE): driver 535.x mixed nodes caused +6-12% variance and occasional downclock.

H100 SUMMARY (speedups vs BASELINE_BF16, per workload)

Table columns: Model | Workload | Mode | TTFT p50/p95 (ms) | TPOT p50/p95 (ms) | tok/s/GPU | Speedup tok/s | ErrRate | CV | Notes

-- L3.1-70B --

L3.1-70B | W1 chat_short | FP8_E4M3      | 172 / 335 | 13.6 / 18.7 | 2,095 | +11.4% | 0.02% | 2.6% | TTFT +4% (launch overhead); decode win holds
L3.1-70B | W1 chat_short | INT8_W8A8     | 166 / 320 | 14.3 / 19.6 | 1,995 | +6.1%  | 0.01% | 2.4% | smaller win than FP8; stable

L3.1-70B | W2 chat_long  | FP8_E4M3      | 435 / 840 | 13.9 / 19.4 | 2,070 | +13.7% | 0.02% | 3.1% | consistent win; TTFT +3-5%
L3.1-70B | W2 chat_long  | INT8_W8A8     | 425 / 805 | 14.9 / 20.7 | 1,920 | +5.5%  | 0.01% | 3.2% | good if FP8 gated for quality

L3.1-8B | W1 chat_short | BASELINE_BF16 | 55 / 95 | 3.9 / 5.6 | 6,850 | - | 0.00% | 1.8% | baseline

Gemma2-27B | W1 chat_short | BASELINE_BF16 | 105 / 200 | 8.6 / 12.4 | 3,120 | - | 0.00% | 2.2% | baseline
Gemma2-27B | W1 chat_short | FP8_E4M3      | 109 / 215 | 7.6 / 11.0 | 3,460 | +10.9% | 0.01% | 2.7% | clean win

-- Mistral-7B --
Mistral-7B | W1 chat_short | BASELINE_BF16 | 48 / 85 | 3.4 / 5.0 | 7,450 | - | 0.00% | 1.6% | baseline
Mistral-7B | W1 chat_short | FP8_E4M3      | 50 / 90 | 3.0 / 4.5 | 8,260 | +10.9% | 0.00% | 1.9% | clean

H100 RAW RUNS (sample excerpts; full raw in artifacts)

Format: Model | Workload | Mode | Run1 tok/s | Run2 | Run3 | Run4 | Run5 | mean | stdev | CV
L3.1-70B | W1 | FP8_E4M3 | 2,080 | 2,110 | 2,090 | 2,105 | 2,091 | 2,095 | 11.3 | 0.54%
L3.1-70B | W3 | FP8_E4M3 | 1,790 | 1,880 | 1,845 | 1,820 | 1,840 | 1,835 | 31.5 | 1.72%  (NOTE: this is the clean/pinned set; earlier runs had CV ~4-6%)
Mixtral-8x7B | W1 | FP8_E4M3 | 4,610 | 4,780 | 4,700 | 4,750 | 4,760 | 4,720 | 66.8 | 1.42%

H100 ANOMALIES / NOTES (trackers)
A1) Variance spike on H100 (Feb 14-16): CV 6-12% on W3. Root cause likely shared node contention + clocks not locked. Mitigation: use runtime-bench-h100 + lock clocks + pin driver/CUDA (see benchmark-lab/pr-851). Status: resolved for reruns.
A2) TTFT regression on tool_json with FP8 attention (L3.1-70B): TTFT p50 +13% while TPOT improves. Hypothesis: launch overhead in FP8 attention path interacts with small initial batch; scheduler batching window too small, increases launch count. Action: test with pr-19911 scheduler defaults; also capture Nsight traces for top 3 cases (Slack thread 1776425512).
A3) Debug logging perturbing benchmark: Found in Feb 19 nightly image; removed/gated in pr-19918. Re-ran affected cells (W2/W4) afterward.
A4) KV cache alignment edge-case: decode instability at long context under FP8 (see pr-19871). Some W3 runs before 2/22 are not comparable.

====================================================================
TAB: A100 SXM 80GB
====================================================================

Environment notes:
- Biggest issue so far has been mixed driver/CUDA across clusters (Feb 13-18). Only compare within "Pinned A100" rows.
- Pinned target: driver 535.161.07, CUDA 12.2 image runtime-bench:1.22.0-rc3, clocks locked.

L3.1-70B | W1 chat_short | INT8_W8A8     | 235 / 440 | 22.5 / 31.4 | 1,240 | +6.0%  | 0.02% | 3.4% | stable

L3.1-70B | W2 chat_long  | FP8_E4M3      | 615 / 1,120 | 22.0 / 31.8 | 1,255 | +12.1% | 0.04% | 4.1% | CV slightly high; rerun queued

-- L3.1-8B --
L3.1-8B | W1 chat_short | BASELINE_BF16 | 78 / 135 | 5.8 / 8.4 | 4,050 | - | 0.00% | 2.1% | baseline
L3.1-8B | W1 chat_short | FP8_E4M3      | 82 / 145 | 5.1 / 7.4 | 4,550 | +12.3% | 0.00% | 2.5% | clean

-- Mixtral-8x7B --
Mixtral-8x7B | W1 chat_short | BASELINE_BF16 | 120 / 220 | 9.2 / 13.4 | 2,720 | - | 0.00% | 3.9% | baseline
Mixtral-8x7B | W1 chat_short | FP8_E4M3      | 131 / 250 | 8.2 / 12.1 | 3,000 | +10.3% | 0.02% | 4.8% | noisy; expert routing variance suspected

A100 ANOMALIES / NOTES
B1) Driver mismatch across clusters (Feb 13-18): produced 5-9% deltas in TTFT on same commit. Flagged in eng-infra thread 1776428891. Only using pinned cluster now.
B2) INT8 correctness failure on a specific shape (L3.1-70B W3 rag_longctx prefill spikes): guardrail added in pr-19841; cell marked "fallback" on those runs. Needs re-run after guardrail to confirm stability.

====================================================================
TAB: L4 24GB (cost SKU)
====================================================================

Coverage note: Only smaller models (<= 8B) and W1/W2. L4 used primarily to validate dispatch + get directional perf.
Environment: driver 550.54.14, CUDA 12.4, clocks auto (locking not always permitted in this pool).

L4 SUMMARY (directional; do not use for claims)

Mistral-7B | W1 chat_short | BASELINE_BF16 | 95 / 170 | 7.4 / 10.8 | 2,250 | - | 0.00% | 4.6% | baseline
Mistral-7B | W1 chat_short | FP8_E4M3      | 100 / 190 | 6.9 / 10.1 | 2,420 | +7.6% | 0.00% | 5.2% | modest win; CV high
L3.1-8B    | W1 chat_short | BASELINE_BF16 | 115 / 210 | 8.6 / 12.5 | 1,980 | - | 0.00% | 4.9% | baseline
L3.1-8B    | W1 chat_short | INT8_W8A8     | 118 / 220 | 8.1 / 11.8 | 2,120 | +7.1% | 0.01% | 5.0% | similar to FP8; pick based on quality policy

L4 NOTES
C1) High CV likely due to shared tenancy + auto clocks. Use L4 only for "does it work" and rough speedups.

====================================================================
CROSS-CUTTING TAKEAWAYS (WORKING)
====================================================================

1) Decode wins are consistent: FP8 attention provides ~9-14% throughput gains on H100/A100 across most models/workloads.
2) TTFT sensitivity: FP8 attention can regress TTFT (esp. tool_json / small initial batches). Scheduler batching window/backpressure settings can make or break the perceived win end-to-end.
3) INT8 matmul gives smaller wins (~3-7%) but has fewer TTFT regressions; it’s a safer default for some model families if FP8 quality gating blocks rollout.
4) Long-context (W3) is the risk zone: variance + KV cache alignment + quality regressions show up here first.

====================================================================
OPEN ITEMS / NEXT RUNS
====================================================================

- Re-run W3 rag_longctx on H100 for: L3.1-70B, Qwen2.5-72B after pr-19871 and after clocks pinned. Owner: Grace / Isabella. ETA: 2/28-3/01.
- Run A100 pinned full set for Gemma2-27B and Qwen2.5-72B W1/W2 (currently missing). Owner: Rina.
- Apply scheduler defaults from pr-19911 and re-run the TTFT-regression cases (L3.1-70B W4 tool_json; Mixtral W1). Owner: Omar / Lena.
- Add Nsight traces for top 3 anomalous cells (H100 tool_json FP8; H100 rag_longctx FP8; A100 mixtral noisy). Owner: Isabella (capture hook in pr-19949).

====================================================================
NOTES FOR PERF CANARY / ROLLOUT
====================================================================

- Suggested initial canary enablement: H100 us-east1 only, models: L3.1-8B, Gemma2-27B (lowest risk), workload mix representative.
- Guardrails needed before broadening:
  - Auto-fallback if TTFT p50 regresses >10% for 15m rolling window (per model-region-mode)
  - Disable FP8 attention for tool_json if schema + low batch leads to launch overhead (pending confirmation)
- See perf-canary threshold profiles (perf-canary/pr-611) and dashboard spec (observability-pack/pr-377).

====================================================================
FOOTNOTES / CAVEATS
====================================================================

- These numbers are internal and include both kernel changes and sometimes scheduler tuning; do not treat as pure kernel microbench results.
- Any external sharing requires methodology sign-off (Claire Dubois) + approved caveats (Henry Cho / Product).
